question: When current G is not certified by absence observations, what can repeated imperfect detection actually rule out and how does probabilistic decision error depend on effort?

design.truth: original full G=A&B&M per candidate world, unchanged
design.sites: Six predeclared grid nodes per landscape selected by highest occupancy-mask variability among 64 original candidate worlds, ties by row-major node index. Selection does not inspect M-release target signs. All other nodes remain unobserved; do not assume their absence.
design.observation: binary detections on k independent visits per site; detection probability p conditional on G=1, false positives fixed zero
design.non_detections: Likelihood (1-p)^k if G=1 and no detection; 1 if G=0 and no detection; any detection has zero likelihood for G=0
design.replicate_generation: Per-site probability of at least one detection across k independent visits is 1-(1-p)^k. The six-site detection pattern likelihood is product Bernoulli conditional on true G, with no false positives.
design.weights: One explicitly hypothetical uniform prior per DISTINCT A/B/M mask triple within each landscape; do not weight duplicate parameter labels. Separate descriptive across-system counts, no population prevalence.
design.decision: For each possible six-site detection pattern, calculate target-sign posterior under a uniform prior over DISTINCT A/B/M mask triples. Decide only if largest sign mass >=0.95, otherwise abstain. Compute exact expected correct/wrong/abstain under the same prior predictive distribution; also report worst-case truth-specific wrong decision probability.
design.computational: Exact enumeration of all 2^6 detection-pattern masks for each of six sites, all distinct candidate mask triples and all true mask triples. No Monte Carlo, no state truncation.
design.baseline: With 0<p<1, all candidates with G superset of detected nodes have positive likelihood, regardless of nondetections. Repeated nondetection never logically proves absence. With p=1, a nondetection excludes occupancy only at the six surveyed sites; all other nodes remain unobserved.
design.no_effect_claim: No natural species detection probabilities or causal inference; report model assumptions.
